seo.defaultDescription: Premium password security platform. Generate, analyze, and protect your passwords with advanced cybersecurity tools.
seo.generatorDescription: Generate secure, customizable passwords for any context. Choose from banking, social media, work, and more with our advanced password generator.
seo.strengthDescription: Analyze your password strength in real-time. Check entropy, character diversity, and get actionable suggestions to improve your password security.
seo.passphraseDescription: Generate memorable yet secure passphrases using random word combinations. Create strong, easy-to-remember passwords with our advanced passphrase generator.
seo.historyDescription: View and manage your generated password history. All passwords are stored locally in your browser for maximum privacy and security.
seo.dashboardDescription: View your personal password security overview. Track password health, strength distribution, and get actionable security tips.
seo.hackingSimDescription: Experience how hackers crack passwords with real-world attack simulations. Test your password strength against dictionary, brute force, and mask attacks.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.introText: At SecureGen, we take your privacy seriously. This policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, and what rights you have.
privacy.dataText: We do not collect, store, or transmit any personal data. Key points:
privacy.cookiesText: This website does not use cookies for tracking, analytics, or any other purpose. We believe in a cookie-free experience.
privacy.localStorageText: We use your browser's local storage only for your preferences and generated password history:
privacy.localItem3: Password history (you can clear this anytime)
privacy.localItem4: All data stays on your device — we cannot access it
privacy.rightsText: Under GDPR, you have the following rights — all of which can be exercised directly in your browser:
privacy.rightItem1: Right to access: View your stored data in the History page
privacy.rightItem2: Right to rectification: Modify any stored data directly
privacy.rightItem3: Right to erasure: Clear your history anytime
privacy.rightItem4: Right to portability: Your data never leaves your device
privacy.rightItem5: Right to withdraw consent: Simply stop using the service
privacy.contactText: If you have questions about this policy, please open an issue on our GitHub repository.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.acceptanceText: By using SecureGen, you agree to these terms of service. If you do not agree, please do not use the service.
terms.serviceText: SecureGen is a free, open-source password security platform. All password generation, analysis, and breach checking happens locally in your browser. We do not store passwords on any server.
terms.intellectualText: The SecureGen source code is open-source and available under the MIT license. You may use, modify, and distribute it in accordance with the license terms.
terms.disclaimerText: SecureGen is provided 'as is' without warranty of any kind. While we use industry-standard security practices, we cannot guarantee absolute security. You are responsible for safeguarding your generated passwords.
terms.limitationText: SecureGen and its contributors shall not be liable for any damages arising from the use or inability to use this service, including but not limited to data breaches, password loss, or unauthorized access.
terms.changesText: We reserve the right to update these terms at any time. Continued use of the service after changes constitutes acceptance of the new terms.
terms.contactText: For questions about these terms, please open an issue on our GitHub repository.
